$comment: MCP client configuration for the LLM router's upcoming MCP surface.
This file anticipates the planned `llm-router-mcp` server package (spec art_MQO8wr9t puts the MCP server in a later extension, not v0.1).
Drop it into an MCP client config (Claude Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json; generic: mcp.json) once the server ships.
The profile path points at a version-controlled preference profile — the artifact this library standardizes.
OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY is optional: selection tools work without it; chat tools require it.
